repository.name: @webex/plugin-authorization
repository.purpose: Environment-selecting entry for webex.authorization. Its Node entry (main dist/index.js, devMain src/index.js) re-exports default and config from @webex/plugin-authorization-node; its package.json browser field maps both the built and the source Node entry to a browser entry that re-exports them from @webex/plugin-authorization-browser. Importing the package imports the selected sibling, which registers itself as public plugin 'authorization' (first registration wins). webex, webex-node, @webex/contact-center, @webex/plugin-device-manager, and @webex/plugin-encryption import it once to obtain webex.authorization. The package has no behavior, state, or tests of its own.

commands.unit-test: [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT] -- package.json defines no test:unit script and the package has no test directory; its two source files are re-exports, and the selected behavior is unit-tested in @webex/plugin-authorization-node and @webex/plugin-authorization-browser

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-authorization package entry
public_interfaces.audience: webex (Node and browser builds), webex-node, @webex/contact-center, @webex/plugin-device-manager, @webex/plugin-encryption, and applications
public_interfaces.notes: main dist/index.js and devMain src/index.js re-export the Node plugin; the browser field maps ./dist/index.js and ./src/index.js to the browser entries, which re-export the browser plugin. Exports are default and config only. Importing registers the selected sibling as 'authorization'; the first registration of the name wins.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not register a plugin or add configuration here, and do not import both siblings from one entry.
